obligations.source_text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

bindings.occluded_subject_phrase: one clearly adult subject remains readable through hair posture hands clothing and body orientation inside the greenhouse aisle
bindings.occluded_identity_zone_phrase: the eye-and-nose identity-bearing region is deliberately covered or turned away while some surrounding head structure remains visible around the fern
bindings.occluder_contact_phrase: a scene-bound hand prop hair curtain or head turn has visible overlap contact or directional cause through the held pressed fern
bindings.occluded_action_setting_phrase: one concrete unfinished action and one identifiable setting carry the image's mood through the open drawer and seed-library aisle
bindings.occluded_boundary_phrase: accidental crop missed focus motion blur empty scene or full silhouette alone does not substitute for the physically overlapping greenhouse prop
